correctness.rationale: The rung transfer matrix T_z=[[1,sqrt(z),sqrt(z)],[sqrt(z),0,z],[sqrt(z),z,0]] counts every legal cyclic hard-core configuration with weight z^{|I|}. Splitting rail parity gives Perron Λ, even secondary -z/Λ, and odd -z, with r=z/Λ in (0,1). Perron occupation m=2r/(1+2r-r²). The two centered covariance channels have exact geometric ratios rho_s=-r(1-r)/(1+r) and rho_a=-r, leading to the two positive Poisson-kernel multipliers by Fourier series. Spectral transfer expansion and Perron gap give uniform fixed-z convergence of the finite cyclic eigenvalues to 4 times those multipliers, so extremal frequencies are at theta=0 or pi. Their factorized comparisons show highest always rail-antisymmetric pi, and lower switches at r=1/sqrt(3), z*=1+2/sqrt(3). Direct symbolic independent derivation confirmed both condition branches and derivative jump 9(sqrt(3)-1)/4; low-activity series is 1+6z+O(z^3). Every finite Gram is positive definite because empty and singletons have positive mass. This is a fixed-z length limit, not a thermodynamic phase transition or joint scaling.
